description: P2 task sources (§19): a Taskfile task with declared `sources`/`generates` (src/generated/schema.js), an npm script running a shell script that sources a helper by a script-relative path (src/generated/client.js), and a Taskfile task running the cargo `xtask` alias (src/generated/version.js, written by Rust code). Generated files are gitignored; the oracle never runs generators, so the tests that load them are declared with expect_affected.

mutations.name: taskfile-sources-edit
mutations.description: edit a schema matched only by the Taskfile task's `sources: [schema/*.json]` (the generator lists the directory at run time)

mutations.name: taskfile-sources-add
mutations.description: add a schema file: a new member of `schema/*.json`

mutations.name: sourced-shell-edit
mutations.description: edit tools/sh/env.sh, sourced by scripts/gen-client.sh through "$(dirname "$0")/../tools/sh/env.sh"

mutations.name: xtask-source-edit
mutations.description: edit xtask/src/codegen.rs, a module of the xtask crate run by `cargo xtask codegen`

mutations.name: taskfile-edit
mutations.description: edit the Taskfile itself (a config of its tasks)

mutations.name: edit-plain
mutations.description: control: edit a source no generator reads
